tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand colour (AppColors.primaryLight / primaryDark; ColorScheme.primary). Fill of primary buttons, FAB and the selected filter chip; colour of text buttons, links, the 2px focus border of inputs and the selected nav item. Pair with `on-primary`. As text: 6.00:1 on `card` and 5.74:1 on `background` in light; 5.39:1 on `card` and 5.95:1 on `background` in dark. CONTRAST FLAG: several widgets still paint the LIGHT value in dark mode (GradientButton and filter-chip fills, icons and text on the Settings, Goals and onboarding screens, icons in the add-investment form, the Overview analytics and quick-stat tiles, and the sort and attach-document sheets); #5b4cdb is 3.30:1 on #0a0a0a and 2.99:1 on #171717, enough for a fill under a white label (6.00:1) but not for text or a border. The AppTextField focus border and the card's 'View Details' link use the dark value.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Deeper brand shade (AppColors.primaryDarkLight, 'dark shade of primary' in the light palette). Defined in app_colors.dart but referenced by no widget at this commit and without a dark counterpart; the same value in both themes. Candidate for a pressed state.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: ColorScheme.primaryContainer (AppColors.primaryLightLight in light, primaryLightDark in dark). Also the GlassCard focus border in dark mode (#a5b4fc, 8.99:1 on `card`). White on #8b7cf6 is 3.33:1, so text on this colour in light is `on-primary-container`, not white.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: ColorScheme.onPrimaryContainer: ink (`neutral-900-light`) on the lilac container in light, 5.26:1 on #8b7cf6 (white would be 3.33:1). The dark theme sets none, so Flutter's default #eaddff applies; no widget paints it.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` fills in the Material theme (ColorScheme.onPrimary, ElevatedButton and FAB foreground: Colors.white in light, neutral950Dark in dark). White on #5b4cdb is 6.00:1; #0a0a0a on #8b7cf6 is 5.95:1. GradientButton ignores this token and paints white in both themes (white on #5b4cdb 6.00:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Secondary colour (AppColors.accentLight / accentDark; ColorScheme.secondary). Used for the 'Import CSV' and sample-data tiles and the 8-30 days 'TO MATURITY' chip. CONTRAST FLAG: #0ea5e9 as text is 2.77:1 on `card` and 2.39:1 on its 15% tint in light. Dark #38bdf8 is 8.37:1 on `card`. The investment card and detail, the Overview tiles and the sample-data banner use it in dark; the FIRE status and the hidden Income Guardian screens use it in dark too. Only a fill, the onboarding page gradient, keeps the light value.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: AppColors.accentDarkLight: ColorScheme.secondaryContainer in the light theme only (the dark theme sets none), so both themes carry the same value.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: ColorScheme.tertiary in both themes: an alias of `graph-purple` (#a855f7).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive outcome (AppColors.successLight / successDark): money-in arrow, 'MATURED' chip, positive change badge, success snackbar fill. Always pair with an arrow, '+' or word. Light #007a54 is deep enough for text: 5.37:1 on `card`, 4.73:1 on `success-bg`, and the success snackbar's white message is 5.37:1 on it. Every tint or pale fill of it (a chip at 10 to 30%) is made from `success-tint`, the brighter green it used to be: text on a 15% tint of that is 4.67:1, on a tint of #007a54 itself 4.34:1. In dark its message is #171717 (9.33:1) and only the white icon is low, 1.92:1 on #34d399. In dark mode the investment card and detail, the Overview and the cash-flow rows use #34d399; the Cash In bar and legend of the Overview chart and the 'Copied' snackbar fill use it too, and so do the Settings, Goals and FIRE screens (status icons and text, the snackbars and dialog buttons of Settings, Data & Account and the guest-backup notices) and the MetricTile change line. Still painted in both themes: the filled ChangeBadge text (on its pale fill), the onboarding page gradients and the Success swatch of the theme preview (fills under white labels).

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: AppColors.successTintLight: the brighter green `success` had before it was deepened for text. The source of every 10 to 30% tint of green that stands alone (the same in both themes), and, in light, of the tint behind green text (chips, icon discs, the MOIC tile); where a widget picks the dark green in dark, its tint is made from that. It is also the green of the FIRE hero card's status badge and progress ring, which sit on a purple gradient where the deeper `success` is 1.0:1 to 1.1:1. Never text or an icon on a white or pale ground: #10b981 is 2.54:1 on `card`. A scan test (theme_aware_sites_test.dart) fails when a tint is made of `success` instead.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the positive ChangeBadge (AppColors.successBgLight). ChangeBadge does not read the theme, so the same pale fill is painted in dark mode too. Text on it (`success`) is 4.73:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Negative outcome (AppColors.dangerLight / dangerDark): money-out arrow, negative change badge, destructive action, error snackbar fill. Pair with '-' or an arrow. Light #cc1926 is deep enough for text: 5.62:1 on `card`, 4.60:1 on `danger-bg`, and the error snackbar's white message is 5.62:1 on it. Every tint or pale fill of it is made from `danger-tint`, the brighter red it used to be: text on a 15% tint of that is 4.63:1, on a tint of #cc1926 itself 4.38:1. In dark its message is #171717 (6.48:1) and only the white icon is low, 2.77:1 on #f87171.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: AppColors.dangerTintLight: the brighter red `danger` had before it was deepened for text. The source of every 10 to 30% tint of red that stands alone (the connection-error disc, the delete-account banner: the same in both themes), and, in light, of the tint behind red text (the XIRR pill on a loss, a cash-out row); where a widget picks the dark red in dark, its tint is made from that. Never text or an icon: #ef4444 is 3.76:1 on `card`. A scan test (theme_aware_sites_test.dart) fails when a tint is made of `danger` instead.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the negative ChangeBadge (AppColors.dangerBgLight); painted unchanged in dark mode.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution (AppColors.warningLight / warningDark): 'MATURES TODAY' and '<=7d TO MATURITY' chips, the highlighted XIRR in the sample-data demo. CONTRAST FLAGS: #f59e0b is 2.15:1 on `card` and 1.91:1 on its 15% tint; white on it is 2.15:1. Dark #fbbf24 is 10.74:1 on `card`.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: AppColors.warningBgLight. Defined, referenced by no widget at this commit; the same value in both themes.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Alias: AppColors.errorLight = dangerLight and errorDark = dangerDark. Use for validation (input error border, error text, cloud-off icon). AppTextField's error border, the cloud-off and warning icons, the error text of the goal cards and FIRE sheets, and the error snackbars and destructive buttons of Settings and Data & Account use the dark value (#f87171) in dark mode.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: ColorScheme.onError: white in light (5.62:1 on #cc1926), `card` ink in dark (6.48:1 on #f87171; white would be 2.77:1).

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Screen background and app bar (AppColors.backgroundLight / backgroundDark; scaffoldBackgroundColor, AppBarTheme.backgroundColor). Body text `text` reads 16.74:1 on it in light, 18.96:1 in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Fill of AppTextField, dialog and selection-action-bar background, unselected TypeSelector chip (AppColors.surfaceLight / surfaceDark). In dark it equals `background`, so a field on a card (#171717) reads as a darker well. Also the dark NavigationBar (HomeShellScreen), the dark sort sheet and the dark exact-amount toast.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, ColorScheme.surface, the theme's NavigationBar and bottom-nav background (AppColors.cardLight / cardDark; CardTheme with radius 16, elevation 0). HomeShellScreen overrides the NavigationBar fill with `white` in light and `surface` in dark. Also the colour of the snackbar message text (ColorScheme.onInverseSurface falls back to surface).

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Default GlassCard fill (glass_card.dart): card colour at 90% in light, #171717 at 80% in dark, over a 10px backdrop blur (no blur on list items).

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px GlassCard border: black 5% in light, white 8% in dark. Decorative; CONTRAST FLAG: 1.12:1 / 1.25:1 against the card, so a card edge is told apart by its fill and spacing, not its border.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard-focus border of GlassCard only (2px, replacing the 1px border; filter chips use `neutral-900-light` / white and type chips the light primary / white, see Chip): `primary` in light (6.00:1 on `card`), `primary-container` in dark (8.99:1 on `card`).

tokens.name: input-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the global InputDecorationTheme (filled: true), used by a bare TextFormField such as the current-value dialog. AppTextField overrides it with `surface`.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: ColorScheme.outline: OutlinedButton border (1.5px) and the global input enabled border (1px). CONTRAST FLAG (non-text 3:1): 1.49:1 on `card` in light, 1.31:1 on `background` in dark.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: ColorScheme.outlineVariant and the Divider (1px). Decorative; 1.13:1 against #0a0a0a in dark.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of AppTextField and MetricTile. CONTRAST FLAG: 1.26:1 on `card` (light) and 1.31:1 on `background` (dark) against the 3:1 asked of a control boundary. Kept as in the source; the field state is carried by the 2px `primary` focus border and the `error` border, never by this border.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text: headings, values, labels (AppColors.textPrimaryLight / textPrimaryDark). 17.49:1 on `card` and 16.74:1 on `background` in light; 18.96:1 on #0a0a0a in dark. Dark-mode widgets frequently paint pure white (#ffffff) instead of #fafaf9.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: Material bodyMedium, MetricTile label, exchange-rate text. 7.63:1 on `card` in light, 7.85:1 on #0a0a0a in dark.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Muted text: captions, 'last activity', empty-state messages, icons beside them (AppColors.textSecondaryLight / textSecondaryDark). Light is 6.12:1 on `card`, 5.86:1 on `background` and 5.61:1 on `surface` / `input-fill`; dark is 7.85:1 on #0a0a0a. In light it is one step under `text-secondary` (1.25:1 apart) and one above `text-subtle` (1.22:1), so size and weight, not the grey alone, set the hierarchy.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: field hints, mini-stat subtitle, separators (neutral400Light / neutral500Dark). Light is 5.02:1 on `card` and 4.60:1 on `surface`; dark is 5.23:1 on #0a0a0a, 4.74:1 on `card` and 4.62:1 on #1c1917. It passes, but it is the faintest text grey: use it for non-essential hints, never for an amount, status or the only label of a control.

tokens.name: white

tokens.name: gradient-hero
